name: Open Rooms
thesis: A personal exhibition with four expansive rooms: sculptural hardware, playful software artwork, community stories, and a quiet personal letter. Huge lavender type and DAVID form the opening on charcoal.
interaction: A sticky four-room navigation tracks the current chapter while every room stays in ordinary scroll flow. A keyboard-accessible hardware selector swaps three real machines and their stories, with restrained transitions and reduced-motion support.
why: Keeps the beautiful type-and-object relationship and purple atmosphere, while giving Stardance software contributions, One Stone teaching, Outpost support, and VEX shop leadership their own compositions. The ending leaves room for Raygen's voice.
